units: centimetres (1 unit = 1 cm), glTF Y-up, belt runs along X, width along Z, thickness along Y

strap_left.origin: world origin, buckle end at x=+0.3

buckle_prong.animate: rotation.z (positive lifts the tip). Locked = 0, open = +0.7 rad

strap_right.role: free end (38 cm) with 5 holes at 6, 8.5, 11, 13.5, 16 cm from the tip

locked.note: hole #3 sits under the prong peg at x=1.75

notes: The right strap rests ON TOP of the left strap in the locked pose (simplified buckle path). A convincing pass-through needs a keyframed path: under the front bar, up, then over.
